hero.headline: Turning Climate Complexity into Strategic Opportunity
hero.subheadline: Green Gate Advisory supports governments, companies, exporters and project developers with carbon market strategy, CBAM and ETS readiness, climate finance, nature-based solutions and environmental policy—helping turn climate priorities into practical, measurable action.

whatWeDo.heading: Integrated Climate & Environmental Advisory
whatWeDo.lead: Climate regulation, carbon markets and sustainable finance are changing how organisations plan, invest and operate. Green Gate Advisory provides integrated climate and environmental advisory services to help clients understand their obligations, assess opportunities and develop credible pathways to implementation.
whatWeDo.paragraph: Our work spans voluntary and compliance carbon markets, carbon project development, emissions trading systems, Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) readiness, climate finance proposal development, nature-based solutions, environmental policy, greenhouse gas accounting and corporate sustainability. We combine technical analysis, regulatory understanding and project-focused thinking to help clients make informed decisions.

pillars.title: Regulatory Insight
pillars.desc: In-depth understanding of EU CBAM, ETS directives, Article 6 rules, and evolving compliance obligations.

pillars.title: Technical Analysis
pillars.desc: Rigorous greenhouse gas accounting, baseline modeling, additionality screening, and MRV frameworks.

pillars.title: Climate Finance Structuring
pillars.desc: Translating climate concepts into bankable funding proposals for multilateral facilities and private capital.

pillars.title: Implementation Planning
pillars.desc: Actionable workstreams, governance frameworks, and decision-ready documentation built for execution.

coreServices.heading: Our Core Advisory Services
coreServices.subtitle: Six integrated service pillars connecting regulatory insight, quantitative analysis, and project execution.

services.title: Carbon Market Advisory
services.summary: Explore carbon market opportunities, assess project feasibility and navigate carbon credit development. We support project planning, methodology screening, project documentation, monitoring, reporting and verification (MRV), validation and verification coordination, registration processes and carbon credit commercialisation.

services.title: CBAM and ETS Advisory
services.summary: Understand potential exposure to the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) and emissions trading requirements. We help organisations assess affected products, organise emissions data, identify information gaps, prepare reporting processes and evaluate carbon-cost and decarbonisation considerations.

services.title: Climate Finance Advisory
services.summary: Develop climate project concepts and funding proposals with a clearer investment rationale. Support may include concept notes, climate rationale, theory of change, logical frameworks, budgets, safeguards, gender considerations, monitoring frameworks and proposal preparation for relevant climate finance opportunities.

services.title: Nature-Based Solutions
services.summary: Develop ecosystem-based climate initiatives that can support mitigation, adaptation, biodiversity, resilience and sustainable livelihoods. Potential project areas include forests, mangroves, wetlands, land restoration, sustainable land use, watershed management and coastal resilience.

services.title: Environmental and Climate Policy
services.summary: Support climate policy design and implementation through policy analysis, Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) planning, National Adaptation Plan (NAP) support, MRV systems, transparency frameworks, carbon pricing and Article 6 readiness.

services.title: Corporate Climate and ESG
services.summary: Build a clearer picture of organisational emissions, climate risks and sustainability priorities. Services may include greenhouse gas inventories, Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions accounting, decarbonisation roadmaps, transition planning, ESG strategy and sustainability reporting readiness.

carbonProcess.heading: End-to-End Carbon Market Support
carbonProcess.description: From an early project idea to potential carbon credit issuance and commercialisation, Green Gate Advisory helps clients understand the steps, requirements and decisions involved in developing a carbon project. Support is tailored to project context, applicable methodology, programme rules and relevant standards.
carbonProcess.disclaimer: Independent standard secretariats and registries determine validation, registration, and credit issuance. Advisory support optimizes technical rigor without guaranteeing external statutory outcomes.

steps.name: Identify opportunities
steps.desc: Screen initial project concepts and identify eligible crediting mechanisms.

steps.name: Screen eligibility
steps.desc: Evaluate standard applicability, geographic scope, and preliminary constraints.

steps.name: Assess feasibility
steps.desc: Conduct carbon yield modeling, financial viability, and additionality screening.

steps.name: Select methodology
steps.desc: Identify approved protocols (e.g. Verra, Gold Standard, Article 6 mechanisms).

steps.name: Design the project
steps.desc: Prepare detailed Project Design Documents (PDD) and community frameworks.

steps.name: Establish MRV
steps.desc: Define rigorous monitoring, reporting, and verification protocols.

steps.name: Support validation and registration
steps.desc: Coordinate with accredited third-party validation bodies and registries.

steps.name: Monitor and verify outcomes
steps.desc: Assist with ongoing monitoring data collation and independent verification audits.

steps.name: Prepare for issuance and commercialisation
steps.desc: Structure offtake strategies, buyer engagement, and registry issuance procedures.

climateFinance.heading: Climate Finance: From Concept to Fundable Proposal
climateFinance.description: Strong climate finance proposals connect a clearly defined climate challenge with a credible intervention, measurable outcomes, a realistic budget and a delivery plan. Green Gate Advisory supports project teams in shaping climate concepts, developing funding documentation and preparing implementation and monitoring frameworks for relevant funding windows.
climateFinance.landscapeNote: Assessed depending on project eligibility and current programme rules:

funds.name: Green Climate Fund (GCF)
funds.desc: Concept notes and funding proposals aligned with GCF investment criteria.

funds.name: Global Environment Facility (GEF)
funds.desc: Project identification forms (PIF) and full-sized project documentation.

funds.name: Adaptation Fund
funds.desc: Concrete adaptation interventions and climate vulnerability rationale.

funds.name: Climate Investment Programmes
funds.desc: Concessional capital vehicles and sectoral climate facilities.

funds.name: Multilateral Development Banks
funds.desc: Technical assistance and climate co-financing structures.

funds.name: Bilateral Facilities & Blended Finance
funds.desc: Catalytic capital structuring and risk-mitigated investment instruments.
